vpn-server.intro_title:
A secure connection
back to your network.
vpn-server.intro_tips: Set up a VPN server on your router to securely access your home or office network from anywhere. Connect with the OpenVPN or WireGuard app on your devices, or use another router to bring its entire network with you.
vpn-server.delete_server_tips: Delete the {protocol} server? Its configuration, keys, clients and route rules will be permanently removed. This cannot be undone. The other VPN server will not be affected.
vpn-server.local_access_label: Allow Remote Access to the LAN Subnet
vpn-server.local_access_tips: Allows remote access to the router (tunnel IP) and LAN resources via VPN.
vpn-server.masq_tips: Rewrites LAN client source IPs to the router's VPN tunnel IP. Disabled only for Site-to-Site setups where the remote peer knows your LAN subnets.
vpn-server.mtu_tips: The MTU you set for the instance will overwrite the MTU item in the configuration file.
vpn-server.client_to_client_tips: This is VPN Client to VPN Client, not Site to Site.
vpn-server.users_empty_tips: The user list is empty. Add at least one user before connecting to the OpenVPN server.
vpn-server.wg_description: Connect with the WireGuard app or another router.
vpn-server.ovpn_description: Connect with an OpenVPN app or another router.
vpn-server.set_parameters_tips_1: The router automatically generates obfuscation parameters.
vpn-server.set_parameters_tips_2: You may edit them manually if you are familiar with AmneziaWG obfuscation, or use the auto-generated ones.
vpn-server.enable_obfuscation_tips: When enabled, the VPN Server uses the AmneziaWG 3.1 obfuscation protocol to disguise VPN traffic.
vpn-server.enable_ipv6_tips: To use an IPv6 address, {todo} on your router.
vpn-server.set_key_manually_tips: The router will automatically generate a key pair for you. If you are familiar with WireGuard and want to update the key pair, you can provide these keys manually.
vpn-server.client_auth_tips: The router will automatically generate client and server certificates and keys; these will be written to the configuration file when it is generated.
vpn-server.advanced_configuration_tips: If you are familiar with OpenVPN, you can also modify advanced configuration settings manually.
vpn-server.file_read_failed_msg: Unable to read the selected file.
vpn-server.save_uncertain_tips: The request timed out. The server may have applied your changes. Close and reopen settings to reload its actual configuration and route rules before submitting again.
vpn-server.route_rules_tips: Add routes to networks that can be reached through the VPN server.
vpn-server.route_rule_dest_already_exists_msg: Cannot enter a destination address that already exists.
vpn-server.unavailable_tips: Unable to retrieve the current {protocol} server status.
vpn-server.obfuscation_tips: Obfuscation is enabled. We recommend connecting via the AmneziaWG app or a GL.iNet router running firmware that supports AmneziaWG obfuscation. Clients that do not support AmneziaWG obfuscation will be unable to connect.
vpn-server.connectivity_tips: Check whether the VPN server can be reached from the Internet.
vpn-server.connectivity_nat_tips: If this router is behind NAT, you may need to set up port forwarding on your upstream router ({gateway}).
vpn-server.forwarding_tips: Ensure the upstream device's port forwarding settings match the information below.
vpn-server.upstream_firewall_tips: Ensure the firewall settings on the upstream device are correct.
vpn-server.connectivity_failed_tips: The server could not be reached. Check your Internet connection and upstream port forwarding settings.
vpn-server.wgserver_peer_list_desc: Each client device that connects to the WireGuard server requires a unique peer configuration. You need to create a separate configuration for each client device; each configuration must specify a unique client IP.
vpn-server.name: Name
vpn-server.peer_deprecated_tips: This profile is no longer compatible with the server configuration. Delete it and create a new profile.
vpn-server.delete_all_config_tips: Delete all client configurations? This cannot be undone.
vpn-server.no_auth_tips: Username and password authentication is disabled. The configured credentials will not be used.
vpn-server.has_auth_tips: Configure usernames and passwords for clients connecting to this OpenVPN server.
vpn-server.use_ddns_export_tips: Use DDNS to keep the VPN endpoint available when your public IP address changes. You can $$$$Enable DDNS$$$$ on your router.
vpn-server.want_use_ipv6_tips: To connect over IPv6, {todo} on your router.
vpn-server.export_addr_tips: The address used as the {label} in the exported client configuration.
vpn-server.export_address_failed_msg: Unable to load the address. Select or enter a valid address above.
vpn-server.export_address_required_tips: Select or enter a valid address above to generate the QR code.
vpn-server.list_failed_msg: Unable to load the client list.
